Title: Information on: What is Joe Biden's employment history?...
Joseph Robinette Biden Jr., the 46th and current President of the United States, has had a long and varied career in public service. Prior to his presidency, he served as the 47th Vice President from 2009 to 2017 under President Barack Obama. Before that, he was a Senator representing Delaware for 36 years (1973-2009), serving as Chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee (1987-1995) and Chairman of the Foreign Relations Committee (1987-1995 and 2001-2003). Before his political career, Biden worked as an attorney in Delaware.
--- End Document 1 ---
